title: dispatch ends the processes a worker session leaves running in its worktree, so land does not stop at step branch
goal: After a headless worker exits, dispatch ends the processes whose working directory is the worker's worktree and whose parent is gone (orphaned MCP servers the session started), and names each it ended, so backlog.py land does not stop at step branch on them
notes: SP-ofvvong6 retrospective: land BG-fdo6bgax stopped at step branch (ops land.end exit=1 2026-10-14T15:57:45Z) because two gk mcp processes (GitKraken plugin MCP, ppid 1) kept their cwd in the worker worktree after the session exited; each of the three workers left such a pair; the orchestrator ended them by hand. SP-j65ihctq retrospective, recurrence: land ST-ceuiynmz stopped at step branch (ops land.end exit=1 2026-10-14T17:14:00Z) on a gk mcp pair (ppid 1) left in the worker worktree; ST-2jsyxkpf's worker left one too, which the orchestrator ended before its land; ST-4o2drppl's worker left none.
